properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Key Vault: Keys Must Have Expiration Date
properties.description: Audits Azure Key Vault keys that do not have an expiration date set. FedRAMP High requires cryptographic key establishment and management (SC-12). Keys without expiration dates may remain active indefinitely, increasing the risk of key compromise. All cryptographic keys must have rotation schedules enforced via expiration dates.

metadata.description: Audit: Report keys without expiration. Deny: Block keys without expiration. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
